title: Fiber Examples
description: Each example belongs to one starter lesson. Follow its setup steps before trying it. These examples need the named tools and do not run in this site playground.

examples.title: Send a greeting
examples.description: A Fiber handler returns an error value. SendString writes the response text. Open GET /hello.
examples.code:
package main
import "github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
func main() {
app := fiber.New()
app.Get("/hello", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error { return c.SendString("Hello, Asha!") })
app.Listen("127.0.0.1:3000")
}

examples.title: Send named data
examples.description: JSON writes an object as JSON. Open GET /book.
examples.code:
package main
import "github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
func main() {
app := fiber.New()
app.Get("/book", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error { return c.JSON(fiber.Map{"title": "Moon Trip"}) })
app.Listen("127.0.0.1:3000")
}

examples.title: Read a route value
examples.description: Params reads a named path part. Open GET /hello/Ravi.
examples.code:
package main
import "github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
func main() {
app := fiber.New()
app.Get("/hello/:name", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error { return c.SendString("Hi, " + c.Params("name") + "!") })
app.Listen("127.0.0.1:3000")
}

examples.title: Read a query string
examples.description: Query reads a query value and can take a default. Open GET /page.
examples.code:
package main
import "github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
func main() {
app := fiber.New()
app.Get("/page", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error { return c.JSON(fiber.Map{"page": c.Query("n", "1")}) })
app.Listen("127.0.0.1:3000")
}

examples.title: Parse an integer input
examples.description: ParamsInt parses a route value as an integer. Open GET /double/4.
examples.code:
package main
import "github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
func main() {
app := fiber.New()
app.Get("/double/:n", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error { n, err := c.ParamsInt("n"); if err != nil { return c.Status(400).SendString("Use a whole number") }; return c.JSON(fiber.Map{"answer": n * 2}) })
app.Listen("127.0.0.1:3000")
}

examples.title: Read a body into a struct
examples.description: BodyParser fills a struct from the request body. Send POST /books with application/json and {"title":"Moon Trip"}.

examples.title: Group routes
examples.description: Group adds a shared path prefix. Open GET /api/books.
examples.code:
package main
import "github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
func main() {
app := fiber.New()
api := app.Group("/api")
api.Get("/books", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error { return c.JSON([]string{"Moon Trip"}) })
app.Listen("127.0.0.1:3000")
}

examples.title: Share request data
examples.description: Locals stores a value for the current request. A middleware can set it before a route reads it.
examples.code:
package main
import "github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
func main() {
app := fiber.New()
app.Use(func(c *fiber.Ctx) error { c.Locals("school", "Oak School"); return c.Next() })
app.Get("/school", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error { return c.SendString(c.Locals("school").(string)) })
app.Listen("127.0.0.1:3000")
}

examples.title: Set a reply header
examples.description: Set adds a response header. Open GET /note and inspect Cache-Control.
examples.code:
package main
import "github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
func main() {
app := fiber.New()
app.Get("/note", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error { c.Set("Cache-Control", "no-store"); return c.SendString("Practice note") })
app.Listen("127.0.0.1:3000")
}

examples.title: Point to another route
examples.description: Redirect sends a location and status. A browser following GET /start reaches /hello.
examples.code:
package main
import "github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
func main() {
app := fiber.New()
app.Get("/start", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error { return c.Redirect("/hello", 302) })
app.Get("/hello", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error { return c.SendString("Welcome") })
app.Listen("127.0.0.1:3000")
}

examples.title: Reply with a missing-item status
examples.description: Status selects a code before a body is sent. Open GET /missing.
examples.code:
package main
import "github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
func main() {
app := fiber.New()
app.Get("/missing", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error { return c.Status(404).JSON(fiber.Map{"error": "Book not found"}) })
app.Listen("127.0.0.1:3000")
}

examples.title: Handle an unknown URL
examples.description: A final Use handler can reply when no earlier route handled the request. Open GET /unknown.
examples.code:
package main
import "github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
func main() {
app := fiber.New()
app.Get("/", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error { return c.SendString("Home") })
app.Use(func(c *fiber.Ctx) error { return c.Status(404).SendString("Page not found") })
app.Listen("127.0.0.1:3000")
}
